hooks.command: if command -v osascript &>/dev/null; then osascript -e 'display notification "Gemini needs your input" with title "🔔 Gemini CLI"'; elif command -v notify-send &>/dev/null; then notify-send '🔔 Gemini CLI' 'Gemini needs your input'; fi

if command -v osascript &>/dev/null; then osascript -e 'display notification "Gemini finished your task" with title "✅ Gemini CLI"'; elif command -v notify-send &>/dev/null; then notify-send '✅ Gemini CLI' 'Gemini finished your task'; fi
